newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MIRAGE 2000 JET CRASHES NORTHEAST OF SKYROS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MIRAGE 2000 JET CRASHES NORTHEAST OF SKYROS.

text.p: A Greek air force Mirage 2000 fighter jet crashed in the sea 25 kilometres northeast of the island of Skyros in the Aegean sea at 10:50 local, a national defence ministry source said.

The jet was on a training mission but no information was available regarding its pilot. A search and rescue mission was underway and it was unknown whether the pilot had managed to eject safely. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
